title: Biological/Cultural Controls, Thresholds & Resistance Management
description: Specialist module covering threshold logic, biological control, cultural/mechanical prevention, intervention compatibility, resistance management and post-intervention verification.
learningOutcomes: Use representative monitoring, crop impact and facility decision rules to distinguish observation thresholds, action thresholds and treatment authority without inventing universal cannabis pest-count triggers.
Compare biological, cultural, mechanical and environmental control tactics by target pest/pathogen, life stage, timing, compatibility, expected response and verification needs.
Evaluate beneficial-organism compatibility with sanitation, environmental conditions and other interventions while recognizing that no single control tactic is universally effective.
Apply resistance-management principles by distinguishing mode of action from brand identity, avoiding repeated selection pressure and preserving label/local-authority boundaries.
Build an IPM decision and follow-up record that links evidence, chosen tactic, authorization, compatibility checks, monitoring method, response criteria and escalation/closure decisions.
